text:
Girl

with brown skin full of kindness

if for any reason you grab the knife

I want you to know

I do not blame you.

And when I drive

along the coast with those old ugly palms

and the living who never arrive

and the dead who do not leave

I want you to know

I do not blame you.

I will remember you

for those long hours of kisses

with our lips swollen with love

and how you offered me your pussy, your soul,

your inside and how I answered you

by offering you the little

that remained of me.

I want you to know

I will always remember the size of your room,

the shape of your body,

your records,

the walls,

the coffee cups,

your mornings, your noons

beside your bad

nights.

translation.title: The Raw Material for Love
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the intimate, coarse register of the source while preserving its repeated refusal to blame.
